# Peg Board's pictures: figures drawn for the app by docs/peg-board/draw.py, its own work, with no source to credit.
# A chart is '= name size columns rows' (the size of peg it is for) and then its rows from the top: . is an empty hole, 1 to 8 a peg
# (red, pink, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet, clear). Rows are half a hole offset; a chart's bottom row is one that is not.
